entities.summary: Duilio Loi was an Italian professional boxer who held the Italian and European lightweight and welterweight titles, as well as the World Junior Welterweight Championship. Loi fought from 1948 to 1962, and retired with a record of 115 wins, 3 losses and 8 draws.
